content: In the second experiment, we used these datasets for training only and compared their performance on our test set of 850 consumer health questions. Table TABREF29 presents the results of this experiment. Logistic Regression trained on the clinical-RQE data outperformed DL models trained on all datasets, with 73.18% Accuracy.
